items.title: Detecting and countering misuse of AI: August 2025
items.summary: Anthropic's August 2025 threat intelligence report on AI cybercrime and other abuses.
items.summaryZh: # 检测和打击人工智能的滥用：2025 年 8 月 我们开发了复杂的安全措施来防止人工智能模型的滥用。但网络犯罪分子和其他恶意行为者正在积极尝试寻找绕过它们的方法。

items.title: National Security and Public Sector Advisory Council
items.summary: Eleven former senators and senior defense, intelligence, and energy officials will help identify high-impact AI applications for US security.
items.summaryZh: # 介绍 Anthropic 国家安全和公共部门咨询委员会 今天，我们宣布成立 Anthropic 国家安全和公共部门咨询委员会，该委员会由两党领先的国家安全和公共政策从业者组成，他们将帮助 Anthropic 支持美国政府和密切盟友的民主国家在战略竞争时代建立和保持持久的技术优势。

items.title: Collective alignment: public input on our Model Spec
items.summary: OpenAI surveyed over 1,000 people worldwide on how AI should behave and compared their views to our Model Spec. Learn how collective alignment is shaping AI defaults to better reflect diverse human values and perspectives.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI展示了针对模型行为规范（Model Spec）的全球集体对齐调研成果，该调研收集了全球1000多名受访者的意见，并将其与现有模型规范进行对比，旨在使AI系统的默认行为能更好地反映多元化的人类价值观和视角。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI公布了基于全球公众调研的集体对齐结果，探讨如何通过公众意见改进Model Spec模型行为规范。

items.title: OpenAI and Anthropic share findings from a joint safety evaluation
items.summary: OpenAI and Anthropic share findings from a first-of-its-kind joint safety evaluation, testing each other’s models for misalignment, instruction following, hallucinations, jailbreaking, and more—highlighting progress, challenges, and the value of cross-lab collaboration.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI与Anthropic首次合作开展联合安全评估，互相测试各自模型的对齐状态、指令遵循能力、幻觉现象以及越狱漏洞等。这项跨实验室的联合测评展示了行业在模型安全评测领域的协作进展与面临的挑战。原始信息显示：OpenAI and Anthropic share findings from a first-of-its-kind joint safety evaluation, testing each other’s models for misalignment, instruction following, hallucinations, jailbreaking, and more—highlighting progress, challenges, and the value of cross-lab collaboration.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“OpenAI and Anthropic share findings from a joint safety evaluation”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI与Anthropic首次公布了联合安全评估的结果，跨实验室测试各自模型的对齐、指令遵循及越狱漏洞。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
